title: 第11章 审问第12章 后续
slug: 兼职管理女子监狱的异端审判官
content_zh:
“你愿意相信我说的吗？”
元素精灵龙维罗娜看着眼前的紫发青年，双手忍不住握紧，璀璨的双眸流转着不安
狄曼列转动了一下钢笔：“我会有自己的判断和求证，你只要说你知道的”
说着，狄曼列敲了敲空白档案：“如果你不愿意回答或者不知道，我也会去调查这件事”
维罗娜小心翼翼的问道：“你是这里的管理者吗？”
狄曼列点了点头：“我是这座监狱的典狱长，如果你觉得那几个圣骑士诬陷你，就把你知道的都告诉我，在水晶城，我有调查和裁决的权利”
听着狄曼列的话，维罗娜咬了咬嘴唇，而后似乎是看向了狄曼列身后，最终抬起璀璨的双眸：
“是的，狄曼列典狱长，他们在说谎，我没有吃那几个孩子，也没有破坏城市”
狄曼列调转钢笔在档案上划了几下：“继续说”
“大概在一个月前，我刚来到这座城市不远处的森林.......”
.......
随着维罗娜的讲述，狄曼列也逐渐得知了事情的详细过程
身为元素精灵龙的维罗娜诞生时间并不长，前不久是她第一次接触人类，再往前的时间她还在认识这个世界，偶尔会和精灵在一起相处
也正因这样，对人类一无所知的她在救下两名坠落悬崖的孩童后，毫无防备的跟着几个声称要感谢她的人回了一座城堡
那些人表面上很友善，给她的食物也很好吃，维罗娜很长一段时间都认为人类是一种比精灵更亲近她的种族
直到这些人类给她送来了一样东西，那是一种味道有些怪但很好喝的果汁
维罗娜很喜欢，每次喝完她都会觉得很开心，忍不住还想继续喝。虽然身为元素精灵龙的本能让她察觉到了一些不对，但她检查过自己的身体，无论是躯体还是魔力都没有丝毫的异常
这样的日子持续了半个月，维罗娜也越来越虚弱，当她察觉到自己的灵魂出了问题时，那些人类已经将刀刃指向了她
也是那一刻，她对这些人类这一种族偶尔散发出的违和感有了认知，那就是被称之为“恶意”的东西
愤怒、疑惑、恐惧、悲伤，各种情绪占据了维罗娜，但她的灵魂已经被侵蚀殆尽，原本能轻易掀翻这座城市的她，却是被几名圣骑士与魔法师压制

神智模糊中，她能感受到这座城市中似乎有一名精灵存在
没有过多犹豫，她直接朝精灵所在的地方飞了过去
等她再次醒来，已经是看着紫发青年切割自己灵魂的时候了
听完维罗娜的叙述和解释，狄曼列有些无语的敲了敲档案板：“维罗娜女士，你好歹也诞生十几年了，没听精灵们说过人类的事吗？”
维罗娜不好意思的挠了挠脸：“她们很少和我交流，每天就给我吃的，远远的向我祈祷”
“遇到的还是一帮传统派精灵”
狄曼列合上档案袋：“总之，你要说的就这些了对吧”
“请你相信我！”
御姐模样的维罗娜忍不住站了起来，连带着单薄的囚服都被她高挑火爆的身材撑开了一些
狄曼列略微抬起档案袋挡住视线：“把衣服穿上”
“啊！”
听到狄曼列的话，维罗娜才发现自己身上的衣服正在滑落，脸色瞬间无比通红，忙不迭的穿好了手术台旁的全套衣服：“非常抱歉！”
而狄曼列则是再次打开档案，轻轻书写：
【认知与情绪符合，达到融入社会体系的标准】
做完这一切，狄曼列再次打量了一下面前的人形元素精灵龙
该说不说，很漂亮，无论是堪称完美的身材，还是那偶尔有溢彩浮现的翠绿长发都已经足够惊艳，更别提那张美的不像人类的脸
如果抛开气质不说，单论精致程度甚至超过了监狱深处的那名天使
至于刚刚的一幕，狄曼列内心也并不是一点感觉都没有，不过他毕竟管理着一座女子监狱，这里的犯人脱光闹事或者调戏他都是常有的事
不说习惯，至少他已经很容易压下情绪波动
“好了，你说的我都知道了，我会去调查这件事的”
content_en:
"Do you want to believe what I say?"
The elemental elf dragon Verona looked at the purple-haired young man in front of her. She couldn't help but clench her hands, and her bright eyes showed uneasiness.
Diamanlie turned the pen: "I will make my own judgment and verification, you just need to say what you know."
With that said, Diamanlie tapped the blank file: "If you don't want to answer or don't know, I will also investigate this matter."
Verona asked cautiously: "Are you the manager here?"
Diamanlie nodded: "I am the warden of this prison. If you think those paladins framed you, tell me everything you know. In Crystal City, I have the right to investigate and make decisions."
Listening to Diamanlie's words, Verona bit her lip, then seemed to look behind Diamanlie, and finally raised her bright eyes:
"Yes, Warden Dimanlie, they are lying. I did not eat those children, nor did I destroy the city."
Dimanlie turned the pen and scratched a few times on the file: "Continue talking."
"About a month ago, I just came to the forest not far from this city..."
.......
As Verona told it, Diamanlie gradually learned the details of the incident.
As an elemental elf dragon, Verona was born not long ago. It was her first contact with humans not long ago. Before that, she was still getting to know the world and occasionally got along with elves.
Because of this, she, who knew nothing about human beings, after saving two children who fell off a cliff, unsuspectingly followed a few people who claimed to thank her back to a castle.
The people were friendly on the surface, and the food they gave her was delicious. For a long time, Verona believed that humans were a race closer to her than elves.
Until these humans brought her something, which was a kind of juice that tasted a little weird but was delicious.
Verona likes it very much. She feels very happy every time she drinks it and wants to continue drinking it. Although her instinct as an elemental elf dragon made her notice something was wrong, she checked her body and found that there was nothing abnormal about her body or magic power.
Such days lasted for half a month, and Verona became weaker and weaker. When she realized that there was something wrong with her soul, those humans had already pointed their swords at her.
It was also at that moment that she became aware of the sense of disobedience that these humans occasionally exude, which is what is called "malice."
Anger, doubt, fear, sadness, various emotions occupied Verona, but her soul had been completely eroded. She could have easily overturned the city, but she was suppressed by several paladins and magicians.
In her confusion, she could feel that there seemed to be an elf in the city.
Without much hesitation, she flew directly towards where the elf was.
When she woke up again, it was time to watch the purple-haired young man cutting her soul.
After listening to Verona's narration and explanation, Diamanlie knocked on the file board speechlessly: "Ms. Verona, you have been born for more than ten years, haven't you heard the elves say anything about humans?"
Verona scratched her face in embarrassment: "They seldom communicate with me, they give me food every day and pray to me from a distance."
"What I encountered was still a bunch of traditional elves"
Diamanlie closed the file bag: "Anyway, that's all you have to say, right?"
"Please believe me!"
Verona, who looked like a royal sister, couldn't help but stand up. Even her thin prison uniform was stretched a little by her tall and hot figure.
Diamanlie slightly raised the file bag to block his sight: "Put on your clothes."
"Ah!"
After hearing Diamanlie's words, Verona realized that the clothes on her body were slipping off, her face instantly turned red, and she hurriedly put on the full set of clothes next to the operating table: "I'm very sorry!"
Diamanlie opened the file again and wrote lightly:
[Cognition and emotion are consistent to achieve integration into societyStandards of the meeting system]
After doing all this, Diamanlie once again looked at the humanoid elemental elf dragon in front of him.
Needless to say, she is very beautiful. Whether it is the perfect figure or the long emerald green hair that occasionally shines through, it is already stunning enough, not to mention the face that is so beautiful that it does not look like a human being.
If you put aside the temperament, the level of sophistication even exceeds that of the angel deep in the prison.
As for the scene just now, Dimanlie didn't feel anything at all in his heart, but after all, he managed a women's prison, and it was common for prisoners here to strip naked and make trouble or molest him.
Not to mention habits, at least he has easily suppressed his mood swings
"Okay, I know everything you said, and I will investigate this matter."
